title: Agenda 2030 Policy Watch
purpose: Convert public-policy claims, video-derived prompts and current source routes into evidence-graded tracking lanes.
boundary: This tracker separates public records, policy frameworks, institutional routes, video claims and hypotheses. It does not treat a claim as proven without records.

sourceInput.summary: The uploaded clip frames a power-control narrative around family names, banking, CBDCs, digital cages, intelligence, religion, WEF/WHO/Federal Reserve and political puppets.
captionsObserved: The three families that control banking
They are building the digital cage.
So I am paying for it with my data and my freedom?
If you don't believe in the enemy, you'll never fight him.
sourceInput.useRule: Use the clip as a lead generator. Each caption becomes a review task, not a verified conclusion.

lanes.name: Agenda 2030 / SDG implementation
lanes.claimQuestion: Which public policies, contracts, grants, standards and partnerships cite SDG or Agenda 2030 language?
lanes.findingRule: Show where Agenda 2030 language appears in public records; do not infer hidden intent from the label alone.

lanes.name: Money systems and payment rails
lanes.claimQuestion: Are payment, wallet, CBDC, stablecoin, banking compliance or programmable-money systems expanding?
lanes.findingRule: Track system changes and access rules; distinguish interoperability from control claims.

lanes.name: Digital identity and data access
lanes.claimQuestion: Are identity, wallet, login, biometric or data-linkage systems becoming required for public or private services?
lanes.findingRule: Upgrade only when records show requirement, scope, vendor, data fields or enforcement mechanism.

lanes.name: Health governance and WHO routes
lanes.claimQuestion: Which health-policy, surveillance, emergency or data-sharing systems are expanding through public records?
lanes.findingRule: Separate public-health coordination from coercive-control claims unless records show enforcement mechanisms.

lanes.name: WEF and public-private partnership routes
lanes.claimQuestion: Which corporations, foundations or public bodies partner through WEF, SDG, innovation or governance initiatives?
lanes.findingRule: Partnership is a relationship line, not proof of command. Map the public role and records.

lanes.name: Family-name claim review
lanes.claimQuestion: The video names Rothschild, Rockefeller and DuPont. What public records support any current institutional influence claims?
lanes.findingRule: Historical influence and current control are different claims. Treat family-name claims as leads until current records support them.

lanes.name: Intelligence, security and emergency systems
lanes.claimQuestion: Are security, intelligence, cyber, border or emergency systems expanding alongside digital infrastructure?
lanes.findingRule: Map public authority, vendor, contract and legal basis before drawing conclusions.

lanes.name: Narrative, religion and values systems
lanes.claimQuestion: Are platform policy, foundation grants, education, NGO or religious-institution routes aligning around shared legitimacy language?
lanes.findingRule: Narrative alignment is a pattern claim; require multiple records across institutions before upgrading.
